name: Paati Vaidhyam (South India)
summary: Rasam, sukku malli kaapi, karpooravalli, neer mor and kanji.

remedies.name: Milagu Jeera Rasam
remedies.howItHelps: Pepper and cumin rasam is hot and spicy; it opens a blocked nose and warms the throat.
steps: Grown-up boils tamarind water with tomato, pepper, jeera and garlic.
Sip from a cup or have it with rice.

remedies.name: Sukku Malli Kaapi
remedies.howItHelps: No coffee in it! Dry ginger and coriander seeds boiled with palm jaggery.
steps: Boil dry ginger, coriander seeds and pepper in water.

remedies.name: Karpooravalli Leaf
remedies.howItHelps: Indian borage leaves are thick and fragrant, and their juice soothes a cough.
steps: Warm a leaf over the flame, squeeze out the juice.

remedies.name: Neer Mor
remedies.howItHelps: Thin, spiced buttermilk handed out to everyone in Tamil summers.
steps: Thin curd with lots of water.
Add curry leaves, ginger and salt.

remedies.name: Rice Kanji
remedies.howItHelps: Kerala's rice gruel is the gentlest food for a sick tummy, with water and salts.
steps: Cook rice in lots of water until soft.
Add salt and sip it warm.

remedies.name: Inji Murappa
remedies.howItHelps: Ginger candy is the South Indian travel trick for wobbly tummies.
steps: Suck a small piece of ginger-jaggery candy slowly during the trip.
